items.title: The Kardashians open Season 8 with a glitchy "AI Could Never" skit
items.summary: The Season 8 premiere of Hulu's The Kardashians, released October 8, opened with deliberately distorted AI versions of the family: Kim with a nose for an ear, Kris with extra fingers, Kylie with a tail. Then the real cast "replaced" them under the title card "AI Could Never." X split into "who approved that AI intro" outrage and "using AI was the point" defenses, and many viewers simply asked "Is this REAL?"

items.title: "WAS IT A FROG": Mom's wild guess about a bug sums up all moms
items.summary: TikToker Jordyn (@jordyndecastro) flicked a bug off her shoulder, and her mom Allison immediately asked, "Oh my god, was that a frog?!" Jordyn captioned it "WAS IT A FROG. she's unreal. i love her." The 20-second clip passed 13 million views, and the comments turned into a mass swap of "moms acting like it's their first day on Earth" stories.
